title: Cambodia LUCT CMS — FSD knowledge graph

nodes.label: Cambodia CMS
nodes.summary: LUCT Cambodia PHPMaker campus CMS (shell title CAMPUS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM 0.9). Desks under cambodia/<desk>/ sharing MySQL campus2_cambodia; nightly batch also projects into portalcambodia. Mid-size LUCT sibling — 481 tables · 296 views · 46 SPs · 83 triggers. Assist provider Limkokwing; no DTEF / TEF POST, no Lesotho NMDS, no Eswatini ssb.
nodes.raisd: M5 expansion reference, not ADR-1 SoR and not Lesotho M4. Prefer LUCT adapter patterns; CAP-53 campus key CAMBODIA (portal_*_cambodia).

nodes.label: Academic
nodes.summary: Registry, faculty, lecturer, CDU (AQA) and in-house (IH) desks around student master, programmes, modules, attendance and results. Faculty (~792 PHP) is the largest academic desk.

nodes.label: Student life
nodes.summary: Services, accommodation and noticeboard. Thick w_* (~52 tables) — dorm/room/occupant/insurance; thicker life surface than Eswatini.

nodes.label: Commercial
nodes.summary: Marketing intake (app_*) and bursary ledger with assist billing (Limkokwing). No r_scholarshipapp / TEF government POST; reporting table rep_scholarship present.

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.summary: Setup is the largest desk (~830 PHP). Reporting, cambodiabatch ops scripts and api_* / portal_*_cambodia hooks. No separate api-service/ tree in this pack.

nodes.label: registry/
nodes.summary: Student master, offers, forms, transcripts and certs (~454 PHP). Includes r_studentcert_cambodia.
nodes.raisd: Student + Staff portals via Portal API; registry remains SoR for Cambodia.

nodes.label: faculty/
nodes.summary: Schools, programmes, modules, attendance and results (~792 PHP — largest academic desk).
nodes.raisd: Student / Lecturer / Staff academic surfaces read through Portal API.

nodes.label: lecturer/
nodes.summary: Lecturer screens for marks, attendance and module materials (~360 PHP).

nodes.label: ih/
nodes.summary: In-house / short-course attendance and marks (~287 PHP). ih_* tables (~10).
nodes.raisd: Later staff surface; short-course path distinct from main faculty desk.

nodes.label: cdu/
nodes.summary: AQA / programme accreditation desks (~242 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff surface for programme approvals evidence.

nodes.label: services/
nodes.summary: Welfare, counselling, visa and insurance operations (~356 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff Services surface; student visa view via Portal API.

nodes.label: accommodation/
nodes.summary: Dorms, occupants and room charges (~197 PHP) on w_dorm / w_room* (only ~1 acc_* name).
nodes.raisd: Accommodation request UX (student) and staff housing desk.

nodes.label: notice/
nodes.summary: Bulletin / noticeboard (~122 PHP).

nodes.label: marketing/
nodes.summary: Applications, agents and recruitment (~280 PHP). Cyberjaya/Botswana-style app_* (10 tables) including app_applicationformonline.

nodes.label: bursary/
nodes.summary: Invoices, payments, receipts and assist billing (~394 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Student Finance read + Staff Bursary via Portal API.

nodes.label: Assist Limkokwing
nodes.summary: Campus-local sponsorship via r_assistprovider / r_assistscheme* and b_assistbilling*. SP literal seen: assist provider code Limkokwing. Not Lesotho nmds, not Botswana DTEF, not Eswatini ssb. No r_scholarshipapp; reporting table rep_scholarship present.
nodes.raisd: Campus feature flag for assist code Limkokwing. Do not invent NMDS or TEF clients for Cambodia.

nodes.label: setup/
nodes.summary: Institution, terms, fee catalogs, user levels and config (~830 PHP — largest desk in the pack).
nodes.raisd: Campus configuration input for CAP-53 campus keying (CAMBODIA).

nodes.label: reporting/
nodes.summary: Population, enrolment, payment and scholarship reports (~594 PHP). Local scratch includes rep_curtermpop_camb / rep_nostudents_active_camb.

nodes.label: cambodiabatch
nodes.summary: Ops scripts (not committed) refreshing portal, registry, bursary, examination and transcript slices into campus2_cambodia and portalcambodia (*_cam / *_cambodia projections).
tables: portal · registry · bursary · examination · transcript slices
nodes.raisd: Replace with campus-keyed Portal API sync at M5.

nodes.label: api_* / portal_* hooks
nodes.summary: api_student_* / api_faculty_* stored procedures and portal_student_*_cambodia tables feed external clients today. Night batch also dumps portal projections into portalcambodia.
nodes.raisd: Candidate read surface for future Portal API ACL — CAP-53 key CAMBODIA.

nodes.label: r_student
nodes.summary: Shared student record hub in campus2_cambodia. Registry/marketing enrol; faculty, bursary, lecturer, IH, services and accommodation attach to it.
nodes.raisd: Identity and enrolment source for campus-keyed Portal API reads.

nodes.label: Portal API
nodes.summary: Raisd anti-corruption layer. Applicant, student, lecturer and staff portals call only the Portal API; it reaches campus2_cambodia campus-keyed at M5+.
nodes.raisd: CAP-53 campus key CAMBODIA; owns assist adapters — never browser → CMS secrets.
